paper.title: Scaling universal Fermi network toward ground states: A diffusion-Monte-Carlo assessment
paper.authors: Yu-Sheng Li, Saskia Poldmaa, Tzen Ong, Ahmed Abouelkomsan, Tay-Rong Chang, Hsin Lin, Liang Fu

results.system_description: 2D homogeneous electron gas, N = 16 (16 up, 0 down), r_s = 30, 60-degree rhombic (triangular-lattice) cell, Gamma point
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of the neural-network wave function (Fermi Sets NQS, N_d=4, N_p=2.5e4 (VMC)) at this N, r_s and cell, without finite-size correction or twist averaging.
results.notes: As printed (energy per electron, in Hartree). Madelung term: included: "const" = Madelung energy of the periodic cell; 2D Ewald. Boundary: periodic, Gamma (twist averaging named as future work).
